title: Egg fried rice

ingredients.amount: ½ cup frozen peas and carrots

steps.text: No cooked rice? Simmer ½ cup dry rice with 1 cup water, lid on, on low heat for 15 minutes, then let it sit 5 minutes and fluff it. Skip this if you already have cooked rice.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the veg (and the onion or garlic, if using) and stir for 3 minutes.
Push everything to one side and scramble the eggs on the other, stirring until they are fully set with no runny bits.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 3 minutes, until everything is steaming hot.

tip: Cold, day-old rice fries up fluffier than fresh.

title: Loaded instant ramen

steps.text: Boil about 500 ml (2 cups) of water in a pot. Take care with the hot water and steam.
Add the noodles and cook for the time on the pack, usually about 3 minutes.
Crack in the egg, stir gently, and cook 3 minutes until the white is completely set.
Stir in the spinach and about half of the seasoning packet. Give it 30 seconds to wilt, then eat while hot.

tip: Half the seasoning packet is plenty. It's very salty.

title: Peanut butter banana toast

steps.text: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread the peanut butter on while the toast is still warm so it melts in.
Slice the banana on top and add a drizzle of honey if you like.

tip: Warm toast melts the peanut butter, so spread it right away.

title: Cheesy eggs on toast

steps.text: Put the bread in the toaster.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium-low heat. Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently for about 3 minutes, until set and no longer wet.
Take the pan off the heat, stir in the cheese for 30 seconds until melted, and pile it on the toast.

tip: Low heat keeps scrambled eggs soft instead of rubbery.

title: Grilled cheese

steps.text: Butter one side of each slice of bread. Put the cheese between the slices with the buttered sides facing out.
Cook in a pan over medium heat, first side down, for about 3 minutes until golden.
Flip and cook 2 minutes more, until the cheese is melted. Let it rest a minute before cutting.

tip: Medium heat, not high, so the cheese melts before the bread burns.

title: Simple tomato pasta

steps.text: Bring a big pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta for the time on the pack, about 10 minutes. Scoop out a splash of the pasta water, then drain.
Put the pot back on low heat with the sauce (and garlic and oil, if using). Add the pasta and stir for 2 minutes until hot, loosening with a little pasta water.
Top with cheese if you have it.

tip: A splash of the starchy pasta water makes the sauce cling.

title: Garlic and oil pasta

steps.text: Boil a pot of salted water and cook the pasta for about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, warm the oil in a pan over low heat and add the garlic. Cook 2 minutes, just until pale gold. Don't let it brown or it turns bitter.
Scoop out a splash of pasta water, drain the pasta, and toss it in the pan with the garlic oil for 1 minute.

tip: Low and slow with the garlic. Burnt garlic can't be fixed.

title: Bean and cheese quesadilla

steps.text: Mash the beans with a fork. Spread them over half of the tortilla, add the cheese, and fold it over.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, until golden underneath.
Flip and cook 2 to 3 minutes more, until the cheese is melted. Cut into wedges.

tip: Press down gently with a spatula so it crisps evenly.

title: Black bean rice bowl

steps.text: No cooked rice? Simmer ½ cup dry rice with 1 cup water, lid on, on low heat for 15 minutes, then let it sit 5 minutes.
Warm the beans in a small pot with a splash of water for 3 minutes, stirring now and then.
Pile the rice into a bowl, add the beans and salsa, and top with anything else you have.

tip: Rice and beans together make a complete, very cheap meal.

title: Veggie stir-fry

steps.text: No cooked rice? Simmer ½ cup dry rice with 1 cup water, lid on, on low heat for 15 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pan over high heat and stir-fry the veg for about 5 minutes, until bright and just tender.
Add the garlic (and ginger) and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in the soy sauce with a splash of water and toss for 1 minute. Serve over the rice.

tip: Cut everything to a similar size so it all cooks at the same speed.

title: Microwave oatmeal with fruit

steps.text: Stir the oats and water together in a big microwave-safe bowl. It bubbles up, so use a bigger bowl than you think you need.
Microwave for 90 seconds, then stir.
Microwave 45 seconds more. Let it stand for a minute (the bowl will be hot), then top with the fruit.

tip: Use oven mitts. The bowl gets very hot.

title: Yogurt and fruit parfait

steps.text: Slice or chop the fruit.
Spoon half the yogurt into a glass or bowl, add half the fruit and cereal, then repeat.
Finish with a drizzle of honey if you like.

tip: Add the cereal last so it stays crunchy.

title: Veggie omelette

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the veg for 2 minutes until soft.
Pour in the eggs. Cook about 3 minutes without stirring, lifting the edges so the runny egg flows underneath.
Sprinkle on the cheese, fold the omelette in half, and cook 1 more minute until there is no runny egg left.

tip: Don't crank the heat. Medium keeps the outside from browning too fast.

title: One-pan chicken and rice

ingredients.amount: 200 g chicken breast or thigh, cut in small pieces

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw chicken.
Heat the oil in a large pan with a lid over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the onion and garlic and cook 2 minutes.
Stir in the rice and 1½ cups water. Bring to a boil, turn the heat to low, cover, and simmer 15 minutes without lifting the lid.
Check that the chicken has reached 74°C (165°F) with no pink inside. Let it stand 5 minutes, then fluff and serve.

tip: It makes two servings. The second one reheats well in the microwave.

title: Chicken salad wrap

steps.text: Only use chicken that was cooked all the way through (74°C or 165°F) and kept in the fridge. Eat it within 3 to 4 days of cooking.
Shred the chicken and mix it with the mayo.
Layer the lettuce, chicken, and tomato on the tortilla, fold in the sides, and roll it up tight.

tip: Tuck the ends in first so nothing falls out.

title: Tuna melt

steps.text: Drain the tuna and mix it with the mayo.
Toast the bread.
Pile the tuna on the toast, lay the cheese on top, and microwave on a plate for 30 seconds until the cheese melts. The plate will be hot.

tip: Squeeze the tuna dry so the toast doesn't go soggy.

title: Tuna pasta

steps.text: Cook the pasta in a pot of salted boiling water for about 10 minutes, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Drain the pasta and peas, then toss with the tuna, olive oil, and lemon while still warm.
Season with salt and pepper and eat it warm or cold.

tip: It's just as good cold, so pack the leftovers for lunch.

title: Lentil soup

steps.text: Cook the onion and carrot in the oil in a pot over medium heat for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the lentils, the tomato sauce if using, and 3 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then turn down and simmer 25 to 30 minutes, until the lentils are soft.
Season with salt and pepper. Add a splash of water if it's too thick.

tip: Tastes even better the next day and keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title: Bean chili

steps.text: Cook the onion (and pepper, if using) in the oil in a pot over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the beans, sauce, and ½ cup of water, plus chili powder or any spices you have. Simmer 15 minutes, stirring now and then.

tip: Top it with cheese or a spoon of yogurt if you have some.

title: Potato and egg hash

steps.text: Dice the potato into small cubes (about 1.5 cm). Microwave in a covered bowl with 2 tbsp water for 4 minutes to soften it.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and fry the potato with the onion for 8 minutes, until golden.
Make two gaps, crack in the eggs, cover the pan, and cook 4 minutes until the whites are completely set.

tip: Microwaving first means the potato browns fast without burning.

title: Loaded microwave potato

steps.text: Scrub the potato and prick it all over with a fork (6 to 8 times).
Microwave for 5 minutes, then flip it over.
Microwave 3 to 4 minutes more, until it feels soft when squeezed with an oven mitt. It will be very hot and steamy.
Split it open, add the butter and cheese, and microwave 30 seconds more so the cheese melts.

tip: Pricking the skin lets steam escape. Skip that and it can burst.

title: Avocado egg toast

steps.text: Fry the egg in a little oil over medium heat for about 3 to 4 minutes, until the white is completely set.
Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with a pinch of salt (and lemon), spread it on the toast, and top with the egg.

tip: A ripe avocado gives slightly when you squeeze it.

title: Hummus veggie wrap

steps.text: Spread the hummus over the tortilla, leaving a small border.
Layer the veg on top, fold in the sides, and roll it up tight.
Cut in half and eat.

tip: A thin layer of hummus on the edge helps it stick shut.

title: Banana pancakes

steps.text: Mash the banana until smooth. Whisk in the eggs (and the oats, if using).
Heat a little oil in a pan over medium-low heat and spoon in small pancakes. Cook about 2 minutes until the edges are set.
Flip carefully and cook 2 minutes more, until fully cooked through.

tip: Keep them small. They're fragile and flip more easily.

title: Stovetop mac and cheese

steps.text: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes, then drain.
Put the pasta back in the pot on low heat. Add the butter, milk, and cheese and stir for 2 minutes until creamy.
Season with pepper and eat right away.

tip: Grate the cheese yourself. It melts smoother than pre-shredded.

title: Peanut noodles

steps.text: Cook the noodles for the time on the pack, then drain.
Stir the peanut butter, soy sauce, and 2 tbsp of hot water together until smooth. Add the honey if using.
Toss the noodles in the sauce and top with cucumber.

tip: If the sauce is too thick, add hot water a spoonful at a time.

title: Eggs in tomato sauce

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil in a pan over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce and simmer 5 minutes.
Make two gaps, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 5 to 6 minutes until the whites are completely set.

tip: Dip bread into it. That's the best part.

title: Sausage and pepper pasta

steps.text: Boil a pot of salted water and cook the pasta for about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice the sausages and cook in a pan over medium heat for 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through to 71°C (160°F) with no pink inside.
Add the pepper and onion and cook 5 minutes more.
Toss with the drained pasta (and the sauce, if using). Wash your hands after handling raw sausage.

tip: The sausage fat is your cooking oil here, so you don't need to add any.

title: Tofu scramble

steps.text: Drain the tofu, pat it dry, and crumble it with your hands.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 2 minutes, if using.
Add the tofu and cook for 6 minutes, stirring, until it's lightly golden.
Add the spinach and soy sauce and stir for 1 minute until the spinach wilts.

tip: A pinch of turmeric turns it golden, just like scrambled egg.

title: Chickpea salad sandwich

steps.text: Mash the chickpeas roughly with a fork, leaving some chunks.
Stir in the mayo, and the celery and lemon if you have them. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread it on one slice of bread, top with the other, and cut in half.

tip: It keeps in the fridge for 3 days, so make extra for tomorrow.

title: Chicken burrito bowl

ingredients.amount: 150 g chicken breast, cut in strips

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw chicken.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken strips 6 to 8 minutes, turning now and then.
Check that the chicken has reached 74°C (165°F) with no pink inside.
Warm the rice and beans together in the microwave for 1 to 2 minutes.
Pile the rice, beans and chicken into a bowl. Top with salsa, cheese and lettuce.

tip: Salsa counts as a sauce and a vegetable. A squeeze of lime on top is great if you have one.

title: Turkey taco skillet

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw turkey.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the turkey and break it up with a spoon. Cook 8 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until no pink is left.
Check that the turkey has reached 74°C (165°F).
Stir in the beans, salsa and corn and simmer 5 minutes.
Sprinkle on the cheese and let it melt for a minute. Serve in warm tortillas.

tip: It makes two servings. Reheat leftovers until steaming hot, and eat them within 3 days.

title: Beef and broccoli rice bowl

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw beef.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the beef 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink is left.
Check that the beef has reached 71°C (160°F).
Add the garlic, broccoli and 3 tablespoons of water. Cover and cook 4 minutes until the broccoli is bright green and tender.
Stir in the soy sauce. Warm the rice in the microwave for 1 minute.
Serve the beef and broccoli over the rice.

tip: Use the leanest ground beef you can find so there's less grease to drain.

title: Garlic shrimp pasta

steps.text: Boil the pasta in salted water for 9 to 11 minutes, until tender. Save a splash of the pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, pat the shrimp dry. Melt the butter with the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the shrimp in a single layer. Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through.
Toss the pasta into the pan with a splash of the pasta water and a squeeze of lemon.

tip: Shrimp go from perfect to rubbery fast. Take them off the heat as soon as they turn pink and opaque.

title: Sheet-pan chicken and veg

ingredients.amount: 300 g chicken breast, cut in chunks

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw chicken.
Toss the potato with half the oil, salt and pepper on a sheet pan. Roast 15 minutes.
Add the chicken, broccoli, garlic and the rest of the oil to the pan and stir. Roast 20 to 25 minutes more.
Check that the chicken has reached 74°C (165°F) with no pink inside. Let it rest 5 minutes.

tip: Cut everything about the same size so it all finishes together. Eat leftovers within 3 days.

title: Lemon salmon with rice and green beans

steps.text: Pat the salmon dry and season it with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the salmon skin side down for 4 minutes.
Flip it and cook 3 to 4 minutes more. Check that it has reached 63°C (145°F) and flakes easily with a fork.
Add the green beans to the pan for the last 4 minutes, or microwave them for 3 minutes.
Warm the rice in the microwave for 1 minute. Serve everything with a squeeze of lemon.

tip: Frozen salmon works well. Thaw it in the fridge overnight, not on the counter.

title: Tuna and bean wrap

steps.text: Mash the beans with a fork in a bowl. Stir in the tuna, olive oil, and a little salt and pepper.
Lay the lettuce on the tortilla and spoon the tuna mix down the middle.
Fold in the sides, roll it up tightly, and cut it in half.

tip: No stove and about 10 minutes, so it works from a dorm room.

title: Greek yogurt power bowl

steps.text: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Slice the banana over the top and add the peanut butter.
Sprinkle on the oats and nuts, and drizzle with honey if you like.

tip: Plain Greek yogurt has about twice the protein of regular yogurt.

title: Egg and cheese breakfast burrito

steps.text: Beat the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat. Pour in the eggs and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until cooked through with no liquid left.
Warm the tortilla in the microwave for 15 seconds so it doesn't crack.
Fill it with the eggs, cheese, salsa and spinach, then roll it up and tuck in the ends.

tip: Wrap it in foil or paper to eat on the move. It stays warm for about 10 minutes.

title: Chicken and broccoli stir-fry

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw chicken.
Heat the oil in a pan over high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until no pink is left.
Add the broccoli, pepper and garlic with a splash of water. Stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes until the vegetables are just tender.
Check that the chicken has reached 74°C (165°F). Stir in the soy sauce.
Warm the rice in the microwave for 1 minute and serve the stir-fry over it.

tip: Slice the chicken thin and across the grain so it cooks fast and stays tender.

title: Crispy tofu peanut bowl

steps.text: Press the tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes to squeeze out water, then cut it into cubes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Fry the tofu 8 to 10 minutes, turning until golden on most sides.
Add the broccoli and garlic with a splash of water. Cover and cook 3 minutes.
Stir the peanut butter and soy sauce with 1 tablespoon of hot water until smooth. Pour it over the pan and toss.
Warm the rice in the microwave for 1 minute and serve the tofu over it.

tip: Pressing the tofu is the trick to getting it crispy.

title: Turkey chili

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw turkey.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the turkey and break it up. Cook about 8 minutes, stirring, until no pink is left.
Stir in the beans, tomato sauce and pepper with ½ cup of water. Simmer on low for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
Check that the turkey has reached 74°C (165°F) before serving.

tip: It keeps in the fridge for 3 days and tastes even better on day two. Reheat until steaming hot.

title: Egg white veggie scramble

ingredients.amount: 6 egg whites (or 1 cup liquid egg whites)

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the spinach and tomato and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the egg whites and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until they're set with no liquid left.
Toast the bread and serve the scramble on the side or on top.

tip: Save the yolks for tomorrow's omelette, or just use whole eggs if you'd like more flavour.

title: Chicken lettuce wraps

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw chicken.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken and garlic 6 to 7 minutes, stirring, until no pink is left.
Check that the chicken has reached 74°C (165°F). Stir in the soy sauce.
Spoon the chicken into the lettuce leaves and top with the grated carrot.

tip: Romaine or iceberg leaves work best. Crisp ones hold the filling better.

title: Shrimp and zucchini stir-fry

steps.text: Pat the shrimp dry. Heat the oil in a pan over high heat.
Add the zucchini and garlic and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 to 3 minutes, turning once, until pink and opaque all the way through.
Stir in the soy sauce and serve straight away.

tip: Nice on its own, or over rice if you want it to fill you up more.

title: Tuna tomato cucumber bowl

steps.text: Chop the tomato and cucumber and put them in a bowl with the lettuce.
Flake the tuna over the top.
Drizzle with the olive oil and lemon, and season with salt and pepper.

tip: Nothing to cook, and nearly 25 g of protein for about $2.

title: Chickpea cucumber salad

steps.text: Rinse and drain the chickpeas. Chop the cucumber and tomato.
Toss everything in a bowl with the olive oil, salt and pepper.
Spoon the hummus on top and squeeze over the lemon if you have it.

tip: Vegan, no cooking, and it keeps in the fridge for a day for tomorrow's lunch.

title: Chicken cabbage soup

ingredients.amount: 200 g chicken breast, cut in small pieces

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw chicken.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrot and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the broth and bring it to a boil. Add the chicken and cabbage.
Simmer 15 minutes, until the cabbage is soft.
Check that the chicken has reached 74°C (165°F) with no pink inside. Season with salt and pepper.

tip: It makes two servings and is easy on the budget. Reheat leftovers until steaming hot.

title: Lemon garlic fish with green beans

steps.text: Pat the fish dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the green beans and garlic and cook 4 minutes.
Push the beans aside and lay the fish in the pan. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until it reaches 63°C (145°F) and flakes easily with a fork.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon.

tip: Cod, pollock or tilapia all work, and frozen fillets are cheapest. Thaw them in the fridge first.

title: Peanut butter banana overnight oats

steps.text: Stir the oats, milk and peanut butter together in a jar or bowl until smooth.
Cover and put it in the fridge for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
In the morning, stir it and top with the sliced banana and yogurt.

tip: Set it up before bed and breakfast is already made. It keeps 2 days in the fridge.

title: Loaded beef burrito

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw beef.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the beef 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink is left.
Check that the beef has reached 71°C (160°F). Stir in the beans and salsa and warm through 2 minutes.
Warm the tortilla in the microwave for 15 seconds.
Fill it with the beef mix, rice, cheese and sour cream. Roll it up and tuck in the ends.

tip: Wrap it tightly in foil and it's easy to eat with one hand.

title: Creamy chicken pasta

ingredients.amount: 150 g chicken breast, cut in small pieces

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw chicken.
Boil the pasta in salted water for 9 to 11 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a pan over medium heat. Cook the chicken 6 to 7 minutes, until no pink is left.
Check that the chicken has reached 74°C (165°F). Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the milk and stir in the cheese until it melts into a sauce, about 2 minutes. Toss in the pasta and spinach.

tip: If the sauce gets too thick, stir in a splash of the pasta water.

title: Sausage, egg and potato skillet

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the potato 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until golden and soft.
Add the sausage and onion and cook 6 to 8 minutes, until browned all over.
Check that the sausage has reached 71°C (160°F).
Make two gaps in the pan and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook 3 to 4 minutes, until the whites and yolks are firm.
Scatter the cheese over the top and let it melt for a minute.

tip: Cook the potato before the sausage so it gets properly crisp.

title: Bacon, egg and cheese bagel

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until crisp. Set it on paper towels.
Toast the bagel and butter both halves.
Crack the eggs into the pan and cook 3 to 4 minutes, flipping once, until the whites and yolks are firm.
Build the bagel with the eggs, cheese and bacon while everything's hot.

tip: Use the bacon fat to cook the eggs and skip the extra oil.

title: Tuna mac and cheese

steps.text: Boil the pasta in salted water for 9 to 11 minutes, then drain and return it to the pot.
Add the butter, milk and cheese and stir over low heat until the cheese melts into a sauce, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the tuna and peas and warm through for 1 minute.

tip: A can of tuna turns a side dish into a real meal, with about 50 g of protein.

title: Rice, beans and egg power bowl

steps.text: Warm the rice and beans together in the microwave for 2 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Crack in the eggs and cook 3 to 4 minutes, until the whites and yolks are firm.
Pile the rice and beans in a bowl. Top with the eggs, sliced avocado and salsa.

tip: Cheap, filling, and it's a full meal in one bowl.

title: Kettle oats with peanut butter

steps.text: Boil the kettle.
Put the oats in a bowl and pour over about 1 cup of hot water. Stir, then cover and wait 3 minutes.
Stir in the peanut butter and top with the banana and nuts.

tip: All you need is a kettle and a bowl. Careful, the water is very hot.

title: Kettle ramen with tofu and greens

steps.text: Boil the kettle.
Put the noodles, seasoning, cubed tofu and spinach in a big bowl.
Pour boiling water over everything until it's covered. Cover with a plate and wait 4 minutes, then stir.

tip: The tofu adds about 17 g of protein to a pack of ramen. Careful, the water is very hot.

title: Sweet potato black bean bowl

steps.text: Wash the sweet potato and pierce it all over with a fork.
Microwave it 5 to 7 minutes, turning once, until it's soft all the way through.
Warm the beans for 1 minute. Split the sweet potato open and fill it with the beans, salsa and avocado.

tip: Vegan, gluten-free and made entirely in the microwave.

title: Lentil and rice stew

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomato sauce and 3 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the rice, cover, and simmer another 20 minutes, stirring now and then and adding water if it sticks.
Season with salt and let it stand 5 minutes before serving.

tip: Vegan, filling and about a dollar a serving. Reheat leftovers until steaming hot.

title: Pork chop with sweet potato

steps.text: Wash your hands and the cutting board after touching raw pork.
Pierce the sweet potato and microwave it 5 to 7 minutes until soft.
Pat the pork dry and season it with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the pork 4 to 5 minutes per side.
Check that the pork has reached 63°C (145°F), then let it rest 3 minutes.
Cook the green beans in the pan for 3 minutes, or microwave them. Serve everything together.

tip: Resting the pork keeps it juicy, so don't skip it.
